reviews.text: Dr Winsom and the whole team have taken incredible care of my cat. They are all so kind, smart, patient, and caring. I wish i was a cat so they could be my pcp! My girl had to get teeth removed and everyone here was so helpful, they explain everything thoroughly, communication is clear and easy, they’re very transparent about pricing. I could not recommend this vet more, they are truly wonderful

Hi Diane, we would appreciate the opportunity to learn more about your experience. Our team cares deeply about our patients and neighbors, and your feedback would help us better understand your concerns. Please contact our Practice Manager, Matt, at matt@westloopvet.com when you have a chance.

I have found the most caring vet for my cats at West Loop Vet.  Dr. Steve Larson is extraordinary in his concern and caring for your pets.  Appointments are on time, staff is wonderful, and I think our cats are getting the very best medical care ever!
Maria, knowing your visit went smoothly is exactly what we aim for. We're delighted to have been able to care for your pet. Thank you for sharing your experience with us!

Had a great experience here! Brought my cat in for the first time - just a routine check up and some vaccinations before travel. He’s a nervous cat, and they were very gentle with him. All costs were discussed before treatment, and nothing was pushed on me. The vet was very thorough in his recommendations and made sure all my questions were answered before I left. I’m moving out of Chicago so it’s a shame I can’t come back - otherwise this would be my new vet clinic!

My Baby Bentley (8LB Yorkie) was attacked by a much bigger stray dog Husky. Bentley suffered two bites, one to his back and another under his right front arm. I brought him in to West Loop Vet and they were more than exceptional. They over exceeded my expectations, Bentley was very calm with them as they were with him. They took their time examining Bentleys wounds and did everything they could to get him back up brand new. I came into the facility very stressed and depressed from the attack and also from the financial crisis at hand. West Loop Vet worked with me through and through. Making sure that the financial plan was affordable and something I could handle. WLV is a heavenly resource for your family and pets health. I can’t thank them enough, I am forever grateful for the support and love shown at WLV. They are my new family for my Pets. Thank you so much WLV!

I had a very uncomfortable experience and I won't be back. They had rolls of blankets as decor in the waiting room and I love touching soft things so I took it out and touched it and put it back. Less than a minute later a staff member came and took them behind the counter. When my name was called to go to the back they put them back out. I was very offended.
Dr. Luke and Kam did a great job comforting Maggie during her exam. She can get a bit spicy when she is scared but their reassurance helped a ton.
Thank you, Toni! We're delighted to know you had a positive experience with us. Your feedback is truly appreciated.
Knowing you had a positive experience with us is truly rewarding. We loved having your pet in, and we're grateful for your trust in our care. Thank you, Kylie!

I love this vet so much! This review is about a particularly great visit we had recently but it truly applies to our long standing experience there.

All of the staff we encountered were incredibly helpful, professional, and extremely caring. The techs that helped us were so loving to our cat and us and the doctor explained everything super well, answering all our questions. We felt very well taken care of!

The staff was very helpful and prompt when we arrived for a first time visit to set up care and also take a look at my dog’s paw. My pup is a very anxious girl but Dr Kaitlyn Saul and the team was fantastic with being patient and gentle with my dog. The estimate and checkout process was very easy and streamlined, and they followed up to see how she was doing! I’m thrilled I chose this vet and would recommend, as someone who works in pet care and previously veterinary care.
Featuring her post-vet reward and nap for being a brave girl!

My senior cat is highly vet-averse and tends to get very upset during visits. Dr Reuter and tech Kam both took their time to make sure my cat was comfortable before starting the exam, which reduced the stress for both me and my cat. 100/10—best vet that’s treated my cat.

Our appointment was at 7:30, and while check-in took a little longer than expected, the rest of our visit was excellent. The doctor and veterinarian technicians were incredibly welcoming, kind, and attentive. They took wonderful care of my four-month-old puppy and made sure he was happy throughout the visit.

The pricing was transparent and the team provided a full breakdown of costs and options. While the veterinary care is an investment, I felt the pricing was reasonable for the area and appreciated knowing exactly what I was paying for. Overall it was a positive experience and I would definitely recommend this clinic to other pet owners.

Love this place and how they treat my pet.
The staff is caring and very professional when it comes treating our family.
Would recommend them over VCA any day.
Wonderful Experience - the staff, the communication and the visit were all very positive.  I truly highly recommend!!!

Brought my cat in for the first time at this office and they were amazing. My cat is not the nicest and they were incredibly respectful of his boundaries and stopped as soon as he started to get upset. Great staff!

We took our cat here for a check-up regarding some specific concerns. We were greeted with exceptional service, full transparency regarding cost and treatment options, and genuine care for our pet. A special shoutout to our technician, Taylor and Dr. Pingue, who helped make our experience the best it could be!

We have always found our visits to be comforting under the circumstances. From the cleanliness, to the personal yet professional treatment by all, it is a great experience. Dr. Lopez has always been extremely knowledgeable and friendly. We are happy to have found such a great place for our fur baby!
Everyone was so friendly and nice and explained everything to me throughly.
Clients like you are why we do this work, Nick. We're grateful for your trust and thrilled to have been able to care for your pet. Thank you for sharing your experience with us!

Amazing service, everyone very friendly and most importantly fear free. They all made our dog Gary feel confortable, even though he hates going to the vet. Dr Lopez was very clear and friendly during the check ups. Very good exeperience :)

Expensive and predatory. I booked an appointment for my cat who tore her claw on a cat scratcher. Was told after making the appointment that there was a mandatory $126 full body exam that does not even include any treatment. Of course I cancelled, because: "no I don't need my cat's body temperature taken through an anal probe when she's suffering with a broken claw". The one star is for the kind receptionist who gave me the heads-up before I made the drive.
Been going here for years. They are staggeringly expensive
Brought in my dog Darla who is very shy and nervous around people. They did absolutely wonderful with her and were very patient. Would definitely recommend.

I don’t normally leave reviews, but RUN AWAY from this practice.

I’ve never felt such utter distrust toward a medical professional—human or animal—than I did after visiting this office. This experience runs across multiple visits.  The overwhelming impression is that every interaction is designed to maximize revenue, not to arrive at the most likely diagnosis or best outcome for your pet.

In my experience, the doctors are incentivized to recommend the most expensive path possible. Even when a common, straightforward explanation is staring everyone in the face, the first recommendation is a long list of costly tests to rule out highly unlikely scenarios before offering basic treatment. Every issue seems to follow the same script.

For example, if a kitten presents with what appears to be a routine case of conjunctivitis, you’ll be pitched hundreds or thousands of dollars in testing before receiving medication. It becomes difficult to believe the recommendations are being driven by medical judgment rather than profit motives.

The result is a level of distrust I’ve never experienced with any healthcare provider. This business model is deeply distasteful, and the practice deserves scrutiny.

I’ll say it again: I have never felt such distrust for any form of medical practitioner before visiting this place.

Find an independent veterinarian and save yourself the frustration. These private equity backed practices are a stain on our community

I have been bringing my cat to West Loop Vet for over four years and my experiences have been inconsistent depending on which vet I see, which makes it hard to give a straightforward recommendation.
The good: Dr. Leslie Juarez-Law has been excellent. She takes thorough notes on my cat's history, responds promptly to emails, and communicates clearly and transparently when building out a treatment plan. Her handling of my cat's osteoarthritis care has been genuinely thoughtful and professional.
The frustrating: My experience with Dr. Alexandra Osborne was a real letdown. She issued an insulin prescription for my cat's diabetes and then went completely silent on my follow-up emails about dosage adjustments. For a condition as sensitive as feline diabetes, that kind of gap in communication is not acceptable, especially at this price point. I ended up relying on online resources to navigate the remission process on my own, which is not what I am paying for here.
My experience with Dr. Steve Larson was also disappointing. After discussing a skin bump, I was presented with a $3,700 treatment plan that included over $2,000 in lab tests, despite the prior conversation already pointing toward a $300 tissue analysis first. After pushing back and removing items I considered redundant, the plan dropped to just over $1,000. That kind of gap between the initial quote and what was actually necessary left me feeling like I was being upsold rather than cared for.
Average: Dr. Paula Pingue has been fine for routine physical exams, nothing to complain.
The clinic has clear potential, but the inconsistency in both communication and billing practices across vets is what keeps this at 3 stars for me.
Dr. Saul and Haylee were absolutely amazing! So kind, patient, and sweet. Made our first vet appointment so easy and enjoyable! Our doggie vet for life!

Thank you, Katherine, for your wonderful 5-star rating! We're thrilled to know you had a great experience with West Loop Veterinary Care. We appreciate your trust in us for your pet's veterinary needs.
They were so gentle with my baby cat.

Thank you, Penelope, for your wonderful 5-star rating! We are thrilled to know you had a great experience with West Loop Veterinary Care. We appreciate your trust in us for your pet's veterinary needs.

Dr. Juarez-Law and the entire WLV team are highly knowledgeable and very clearly care for the wellbeing of both of my cats. I never feel that they are rushing through the appointment, and I always feel that the team’s entire focus is on my pet during their visit.

The team is thoughtful and considerate about all of my questions. They always thoroughly explain options, the pros and cons of each option, costs, and turnaround estimates with me upfront. I never feel surprised or uninformed.

This is why we have kept coming to WLV after moving out of downtown - because I know my cats have the best care with WLV.

The doctors here are VERY knowledgeable and truly care about their patients. The dental day open house was an amazing experience. I had several questions at each station and they were all welcomed. Those questions were met with grace, professional knowledge, and passion. All 4 of my dogs have been patients here. From the easy goers to the anxious ones, the doctors and their team knew how to adjust and adapt to ensure my pets didn’t experience any unnecessary stress while still being able to proceed with the procedures.

I absolutely loved this place. Quick check in, I made them our primary care for our dog and I couldn’t be happier, they’re very vocal and passionate. Very patient to answer all of my questions. Definitely coming back here again

WLVC has the best Veterinarians and technicians in the city!
No matter who had seen any of my fur babies they were always pampered and loved. Special shout out to Dr Osborne & Dr Juarez for always looking out for my babies!
( seriously though, all the doctors are unique in their own ways, but such badasses with what they do)

Sal , Taylor , and Haylee have been wonderful assistants making things easy to understand during appointments , and to all the rockstar technicians who helped with slinky’s spay & xochitls dental!

Your pets are in great hands from start to finish.

Dr. Vlahos was excellent with my two cats. This was our first visit at West Loop Veterinary Care and it exceeded expectations. He was very thorough, gave helpful explanations/recommendations, and made sure all questions were answered.

Hi, I’ve been following Dr Larson at West Loop Veterinarian Care for over 20 years. I just want to say that he is one of the best vets in the city of Chicago. He gives it 110% and really cares for the animals that are brought in. I think everyone at West Loop is the same way. I have never had a bad experience there. Thank you, West Loop Veterinarian Care
Yolanda

WLVC is where I've taken my Frenchie for the past 4 years; and he's always been well taken care of. Taylor from my most-recent visit, in particular, was so good with my dog, he didn't want to leave!!! I highly recommend this clinic for your pet's needs.

Dr. Winson and Dr. Larson are the best. They are true partners in my pupper’s treatment. In addition to their expertise in managing his health, it’s clear that they enjoy him and genuinely care about him. Plus, after an appointment, someone from the office always follows up to find out how my boy is doing and if we have any questions.

Our experience with West Loop Veterinary Care has been extremely positive.
We came here after having a very poor experience with a previous VCA clinic, and we were a bit nervous at first. However, from the moment we arrived, everything exceeded our expectations.
The staff is highly qualified and incredibly kind. Ivy is a shelter dog and quite shy, so she needs time and the right approach to build trust. The team handled everything beautifully: they were patient, gentle, and made sure to involve us through every step.
We also really appreciated the transparency: pricing is clear, and the bill is always reviewed with you before proceeding with any tests or treatments.
A special thank you to Haylee and Kaitlyn for their fantastic work! We truly appreciate the care and attention they gave to Ivy.
Couldn’t recommend them more!

West Loop Veterinary Care went above and beyond to help us euthanize our axolotl.  While it wasn’t something they normally do, they were able to figure out how to help us and ease our pets suffering. Everyone was kind, compassionate and helpful.

We had to visit West Loop Pet Care for the first time under really difficult circumstances, and I can’t say enough about the kindness from Dr. Reuter, Jess, and the entire team.

Our axolotl needed to cross the rainbow bridge, and after calling every animal hospital in Chicago - including exotic specialists - no one was willing to help us.

Even though West Loop doesn’t typically treat exotics, they didn’t hesitate. They welcomed us in and treated us with so much compassion, care, and understanding during an incredibly painful moment.

Saying goodbye to a pet (no matter what kind) is never easy, and it meant everything to have a team willing to step in when no one else would.

Because of this experience, we will be bringing all of our animals to West Loop Pet Care moving forward.
I’ve been bringing Wesley to WLV and every time we have a fantastic experience. The techs and drs are all phenomenal.
West Loop Veterinary care is like the Mayo Clinic for dogs!  This review really comes from the heart.  I can't say enough about what a positive experience my pup Moxie & I have had with them.

Miss Mittens is much better now, thank you!

My cat worries were systematically worked through.
Convenient, helpful, and lots of attention to detail.

Really great folks here!

If you’re looking for a new vet, I highly recommend giving West Loop Veterinary care a visit.

We switched over around a year ago after a negative experience elsewhere. Most recently we were able to get a last minute sick pet appointment with Dr. Winson for our senior dog. The team couldn’t have been more accommodating, transparent and kind.

Our exam was very thorough. Costs were very clearly outlined and options discussed before any care was received. We received a full written summary of our visit via email and separate email checking in on our dog very early the next morning.

Thank you all for making what could have been a confusing, stressful experience one that was clear and professional. This has been by far the best vet experience we have had.
Thank you Allison!

This establishment has honestly changed my life! The vets and the staff are people who truly care for YOU and your loved furry children! I honestly don’t think I could’ve asked for a better vet and team to care for my babies. They have diagnosed health issues other vets have overlooked, they go the extra mile to ease your mind and find you solutions. Even on my hardest day of putting my soul dog down, they made the process feel like I was surrounded by family from the time I walked through the door. To even now weeks later I’m still receiving love and reminders I’m being thought of by them! I’m in absolute shock that they go so above and beyond! My babies truly made friends that I never thought even possible for them to have. Absolutely worth every penny!!! My babies have worked with almost every single doctor because they can be so complicated and this establishment truly works as a team!! I do want to shout out Dr Juarez and Dr Pingue! They have changed not only my life but my 4 furry children’s lives ❤️❤️ thank you for all you do and providing the care you do!

Clean great folks first time going here the staff was friendly. They respected Coco spoke to him as I do. The doctor super good they explained everything to me price is reasonable. Coco decide that will be is place to go.

Everyone from the front desk staff, to the technician, to the doctor was so kind and did an amazing job at calming my anxious kitty for her appointment. This was my first time visiting this clinic and I had a 10/10 experience! I would definitely recommend bringing your pets here for help. Thank you for such a great experience!
Really enjoyed my experience at West Loop Veterinary Care. Dr. Osborne and Kam were both extremely knowledgeable and helpful with all my questions. We will definitely keep coming here.

Had my first appointment being new to Chicago with my chihuahua mix Axel.  He's had some vet fear in the past and I was a little concerned about getting his booster shots specifically.  Dr Saul and Vet Tech Aby were AWESOME!  I was very impressed with how much time they spent with my dog and I, and we worked together as a team to distract my pup in a positive way prior to and during the exam and injections.  The approach of "fear free care" is accurate.  Would recommend!

Dr. Winson was absolutely incredible with our cat, Sadie, when we brought her in on suspicion of her getting into some lillies that could've been lethal to her. Dr. Winson was incredibly knowledgeable and compassionate with us. She patiently explained everything that she was analyzing on Sadie's bloodwork and panels and kept us updated regularly through a very stressful and emotional experience. I could tell she genuinely cared and was concerned about Sadie; this level of compassion and empathy is rare and made me feel so comfortable and confident that Sadie was well looked after and would get the care she needed. We did not have to wait for a single minute once we arrived with Sadie and explained her situation, they identified her as a high-priority patient due to the severity of her incident and saw her immediately. I am so grateful to WL Vet Care, from the receptionists to Dr. Winson. Everyone was so kind and communicative throughout the whole process. I cannot recommend this clinic and Dr. Winson highly enough!

The staff was so great. I cannot even express how happy I was with how they handled my anxious pup. She needed ear drops applied, which is impossible for me to do alone. Two techs worked together to give her the drops with no head-whipping or escape attempts. It was remarkable. I also very much appreciated Dr. Larson’s after-visit email. It was thorough and helpful and made us feel like he really cares about our pup.

Dr. Osborne is an amazing vet! She's so kind, thorough, a great listener, and she genuinely cares. I've had really traumatic vet visits in the past so I'm always so worried about trying somewhere new. Dr. Osborne and the vet technicians are SO good with my cat. Every visit is such a low stress, positive experience. My kitty even purrs during the exams! I cannot recommend West Loop Veterinary Care enough, especially if you have sensitive or anxious cats.

Great place - everything you want from a vet!  Highly knowledgeable and compassionate vet and vet techs, took as much time with me as needed so I understood the treatment tests and options, provided information about costs, check out happened in the room so I didn't have to manage my curious puppy in the waiting room as pets arrived/left.  Professionally run. Highly recommend!

I took my cat here to get a second opinion on his vomiting and mild urine crystallization after having a negative experience with the Lovet care team who were trying to change his entire diet just to sell their Dr. Hill’s food. They called me soon after seeing my appointment request and asked if we could come in that day instead. I saw Dr. Saul and she listened to my concerns with care and treated my cat with much kindness and respect. She talked to him soothingly through every step of the exam. I love that they have a no-fear policy and won’t force anything against your pet’s will. She reassured me that the crystals noted in his urine test were mild, and could be a fluke if the test had been sitting out too long and no immediate action was required, just monitoring for any changes at home. Same for vomiting, she gave me a whole breakdown of costs for further exams if I chose to do so, and recommended a prebiotic supplement, but otherwise I could continue monitoring at home since I finally found a food that has been working for him. I left feeling reassured that my baby was healthy and that I have a supportive team should anything change. They even followed up with me through email to check in on how he was doing after the visit. They genuinely care about you and your pets here, I appreciated their support very much.

I cannot thank West Loop Veterinary Care in Chicago enough for the outstanding service they provided. I urgently needed a USDA certificate for my dog in order to travel internationally, and the clinic truly came to the rescue. The entire staff was professional, kind, and extremely efficient, making what could have been a very stressful situation so much easier to manage.

A special mention goes to Jocelyn, who absolutely saved the day. At the airport, the airline staff member in charge of our check-in was completely unprepared — she had no idea what the USDA certificate was, what the required vaccines meant, or how to process the paperwork correctly. Jocelyn personally called the airline desk and, with incredible patience and professionalism, explained step by step everything the staff member needed to know: what the certificate was, why it was necessary, how to interpret the details, and how to proceed with the check-in.

Thanks to Jocelyn’s knowledge and persistence, the airline staff finally understood the documentation and was able to complete our check-in successfully. Without her, we would not have been able to board our flight with our dog, Chucky.

This clinic goes above and beyond in every sense — professionalism, expertise, and genuine care for their clients and pets. I wholeheartedly recommend West Loop Veterinary Care to anyone in need of veterinary services. They are truly the highest standard of excellence.

My girl fur baby was attacked & injured by another dog on 9/23/2025.  I called around to various urgent care facilities but West Loop stood out among them all.  Of course I was a a wreck after the attack.  I couldn’t stop crying as I talked to the receptionist.  The compassion and kindness given to me, over the phone, touched my heart.  We entered the office and felt at ease. The entire staff provided excellent care to my baby & myself.  Now, the fur baby is healing.  The phone calls received from Dr. Winson & staff following our visit put the cherry on top of sincere care. Thanks so much for helping us!!  Alicia & Bella (the fur baby)!🐾

Nicole Reuter is genuinely the best veterinarian I’ve ever been to. She is knowledgeable, kind, caring, and makes both me and my pet feel incredibly comfortable. My cat has had so many health issues and the only reason I feel confident in her recovery and my own ability to provide for her is because Dr. Reuter is her vet. I have never in my life been so satisfied in any health care, including doctors I’ve seen for my own health. I can’t recommend Dr. Reuter enough, and this review does not do her justice. I would give her my own kidney if I could, she’s done that much for me and my pet. I will never see another vet as long as Dr. Reuter is still in practice. Both my cat and I are genuinely excited to see her. Going to the vet feels like visiting a friends house.

Additionally Cam is a wonderful technician and so knowledgeable and kind as well. These two people make the doctor’s office feel like home.

I really appreciate that they squeezed me in last minute! Everyone at the clinic was very friendly and kind. The vet, Emily, was extremely thorough and compassionate. She made sure all my questions were answered and concerns addressed. I was impressed with the level of care for such an affordable price and I know if my kitty should have an emergency in the future he would be in very good hands.

Walking in here is like walking in to the bar in Cheers. The staff knows your pet by name (and is always glad you came.) My two cats are treated gently and kindly; I’ve never heard a single sound of distress except for a squeak of annoyance at an injection.

The staff are all awesome, from the receptionist to the techs and the doctors. I really thank them for all their work!

Caution Regarding West Loop Veterinary Care

I strongly advise pet owners to exercise caution before taking their animals to West Loop Veterinary Care.

I brought our healthy 9-year-old cat in for a routine annual checkup, during which she was diagnosed with a mild ear infection. The clinic prescribed ear drops, which we administered diligently over a two-week period. Upon returning for a follow-up visit, a veterinary technician took her to the back for what was described as a “deep cleaning.”

When she was returned to us after the procedure, she was visibly traumatized. Her symptoms were so severe that we feared she had suffered a stroke. She was later diagnosed with vestibular syndrome, a condition that affects balance and coordination, likely triggered by the deep cleaning procedure.

Following this incident, we immediately sought care from another veterinary practice and consulted a neurologist at MedVet on North California, who has been exceptional. Unfortunately, our cat is now unable to walk, disoriented, and has completely lost her sense of balance. Her prognosis remains uncertain, and recovery — if possible — will take weeks or months.

We are heartbroken. Our cat is suffering, and we were never informed of any potential risks associated with the cleaning procedure. Moreover, the clinic has not accepted responsibility for what occurred. While they refunded the $800 we paid them, they declined to contribute toward the additional $10,000 in veterinary and specialist care we have incurred since the incident.

In our experience, West Loop Veterinary Care failed to provide adequate communication about the risks, and the outcome has been devastating for our pet and our family. I do not recommend their services.

I have reached the point where I will reconsider going back. Pet owners beware and please advocate for your animal, but also your pocketbook. We went in for a mild allergies and they ran us a tab of almost $700. The vet came off horribly uneducated, claiming he didn't know if it was allergies or chemical burns and tried to prescribe oral medication, topical medication and a soak asking us to come back again in two weeks only to charge us more potentially. They need to be asking for consent before providing any service. They start at the appointment with a physical exam that cost $115 without asking my permission. There was an entire charge on my invoice for miscellaneous medication, they wanted to charge me for a cone without asking. Review your invoice before they get your signature. I have an out-of-state family member who owns her home practice and she is appalled at the up-charge being used here on the services and medications.. last time it was $900 for a mild cough. I could only imagine what the cost would be if something serious actually happened. We have to protect our pets, but please speak up for yourself.

This vet is amazing! The staff, doctors and vet techs have been nothing but incredible, and understanding to our dogs needs. We have a large breed dog with super high energy and they are able to accomodate and be patient with him.
Special shoutout to the 2 doctors we've had, Dr. Larson and Dr. Osborne, they we're both so knowledgable and knew exactly what our little guy needed during the visits. Most recently, we also want to give Chris S. a huge shoutout and thank you!! He was very patient, and explained everything to us so well. You can just tell everyone who works here truly loves animals! It's so great to have a vet you trust nearby! Definitely recommend :)

The team at West Loop Veterinary Care is incredibly kind, knowledgeable, and truly cares about your pet’s well-being. The doctors were extremely helpful and caring, taking the time to explain everything and make sure we felt at ease. Highly recommend!

I have been bringing my dog to West Loop Vet for the past 2 years or so. Each time he seems more comfortable and I believe that is due to the very kind and gentle staff. I called first thing this morning and WLV had an appointment available to treat Freddie’s pink eye. We have gotten a dental procedure done in November as well and could not have asked for better care. Plus, the parking out front is very convenient!

I brought my cats in for their annual exam, and while the doctors are fantastic, the office’s pricing practices are deeply concerning. I was charged $264.13 for a 3-year Feline Rabies vaccine, and my pet insurance only reimbursed $20. I called the insurance company they were shocked. I also called around to multiple local vets in the WL area, to be also be shocked on the pricing, while they provided theirs over the phone and the range shold be between 120$ - $160.

When I contacted the office to express concern, the practice manager explained that their prices reflect investment in high-quality staff, training, equipment, and facilities.
I mean come on standardized vaccines do not vary significantly in content or cost from one office to another. A 60%+ markup over the high end of local prices for a well-established vaccine is excessive. I responded with this context and received no reply.

It’s disappointing, because the clinical care is excellent, the pricing is just morally wrong.
I always know that my dog is valued and cared for. The vet, tech team, and phlebotomist put her needs first and created an environment for her to feel cared and loved.

Everyone we interacted with at West Loop was very kind and competent. We trust Dr Pingue's knowledge, her thoroughness, and her caring for our cat. And our cat feels better, so that always makes us happy!
“The staff was so kind and professional. They took great care of my dog and explained everything clearly. I felt confident my furry friend was in the best hands!”

We were patients at West Loop Veterinary Care for four wonderful years with our beloved dog, Blue. From the start, the team was always quick to answer the phone and make room for urgent visits when needed. Yes, their services are on the pricier side, but the quality of care, responsiveness, and compassion make it absolutely worth it.

Dr. Osborne, in particular, holds a very special place in our hearts. In November, Blue was diagnosed with a severe, treatment-resistant form of idiopathic epilepsy. He was ultimately transferred to a specialist, and after a difficult battle and complications from medications, we had to make the heartbreaking decision to say goodbye to him in late January.
Throughout this entire journey, Dr. Osborne was nothing short of extraordinary. She called us multiple times just to check in, even when Blue was no longer under her direct care. Any time West Loop received word of an emergency visit, she would follow up within 48 hours—not just as a vet, but as someone who genuinely cared. She listened, supported, and showed up for us in ways we’ll never forget.

Tory in the pharmacy also deserves a shout-out—she always remembered us by name and quickly processed any refill requests, which was a huge help during a stressful time. And during emergencies, any available doctor was willing to jump on the phone and guide us through the steps to get Blue the care he needed. Every member of the staff showed us deep empathy and support.

West Loop Vet is more than a clinic—they’re a true partner in your pet’s health and well-being. We’ll forever be grateful for the care they gave Blue and the kindness they showed us during his toughest days.

Dr. Trybah and Kam did an amazing job caring for my sick puppy. Dr. Trybah is very knowledgeable and stayed in constant communication while they were treating my dog in the back. Definitely pricier than most other vets, but it’s 100% worth it!

I've been taking my dog here for a few years now after a poor experience with his first vet, and I can't recommend them enough. They are always so kind and accommodating to my anxious pup. Shout out Dr. Emily Winson and her whole team for making his shots and check up as easy as possible.

We loved our time at the West Loop Vet Center. They were highly recommended from others in our building and were so glad to find them. We just moved here and needed a quick appointment for our 2 dogs. They were able to schedule us within days. Our vet and vet tech were amazing with our boys. Including our older rescue that is very skiddish, anxious, and aggressive. We’ll be back. So happy to find yall.

I’m from a town about two hours from the city. My 12-year-old dachshund, Jaxon, had been battling heart failure, and overnight, he got worse. West Loop Vet was the closest clinic to me, so I took him there. Unfortunately, nothing could be done to save him, but the kindness and compassion they showed both me and Jaxon in those final moments made an unbearable moment a little easier.

We're hoping to have a surgery done for our dog at West Loop Veterinary Care, since they're one of the few clinics able to do laparoscopic procedures. Since this isn't our dog's primary care vet, we needed to have an eval appointment first.
